input.quote: Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
input.rationale: The cap is mutual, but one month of Fees actually paid is far below our walk-away floor of six months' fees, and "without exception" purports to override the Excluded Claims regime in 21.2–21.3. We have reset the basis to the greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000 and restored Excluded Claims (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) as uncapped. Note 1.5 also excludes one-time implementation charges from "Fees", which further thins the base.

input.quote: 20. INDEMNIFICATION 20.1 Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
input.rationale: Section 20 contains only a sweeping one-way Customer indemnity ("every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services") and no Vendor indemnity at all — our walk-away position. Sections 9.3 and 19.4 both assume a Vendor indemnity and 9.3 cross-refers to a non-existent Section 20.5. We have narrowed our indemnity to Customer-provided content and our breach of law, and added the Vendor IP/breach-of-law/data-breach/wilful-misconduct indemnity with standard procedure and infringement remedies.

input.quote: During the term and for twenty-four months thereafter, Customer shall not develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory.
input.rationale: A 24-month post-term, worldwide, undefined-scope non-compete on Customer hits two walk-away triggers (post-term longer than 12 months and undefined scope) and squarely contradicts Section 12.3, which states Customer has made no non-compete commitment. Deleted; fallback of a named-product, term-only restriction offered if needed.

input.quote: Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
input.rationale: This is exclusive dealing for the full three-year term with no performance-based exit — our walk-away position — and it conflicts with Section 12.3's acknowledgement that Customer has made no exclusivity commitment. Deleted, with a defined-category/12-month/SLA-exit fallback available.
